submission.natural_language_explanation: L0/N1408+ is a layer-0 token-identity lookup, not a context detector: its strength at a position is a fixed property of the single tokenizer piece there (token identity explains 100% of its scan variance, integrated gradients put 100% of every peak on that piece, and the same piece gives the same value in every context and at every position), so predict ACTIVE iff some piece of the text is one of a fixed ~2,200-entry firing set (4.4% of the 50,277 vocabulary) and INACTIVE iff every piece is outside it. The set is a fixed list, not a meaning class: it holds ordinary words that fire ('According'/' According'/' according' 1.73/1.49/1.13, 'Despite'/' despite', 'Instead', 'history'/'History', 'politics', 'evidence', 'Democratic', 'Regardless', ' fossil', and the bare capitalised pieces 'Introduction', 'References', 'Category', 'Opposition', 'Bayesian', plus the piece 'prud' inside 'jurisprudence') next to a long tail of rare, technical, foreign and name pieces, it is exact about the piece ('Introduction' 1.17 fires but ' introduction' 0.00 does not; 'References' 1.02 fires but ' References' 0.05 does not; ' opposed' 1.28 fires but 'opposed' 0.22 does not), and equally formal words never fire in any capitalisation or spacing ('however', 'although', 'therefore', 'government', 'report', 'important', 'analysis', 'statement', 'court', 'policy', 'proposal', 'parliament', 'methodology', 'committee', 'construction', 'region').

Following the excellent start made by the region in their 38-28 victory over the Blues on Friday, the DOSC have been involved in a number of community events at clubs around the region which show the strength of mini and junior rugby, not to mention the strength of local communities across Gwent.
On Saturday afternoon, the DOSC had the pleasure of attending the Sophie's 7's tournament at New Tredegar RFC.
The sevens tournament is held each year to raise money for the Sophie Pearson Community Fund, which gives thousands each year to the Children’s Heart Unit at the University Hospital of Wales in Cardiff. The event has raised over £100,000 over the last 10 years and this year's event raised an incredible £4,600 on the day.
Sophie, a former White Rose Primary School and Rhymney Comprehensive pupil, died aged 12 in November 2006 after being diagnosed with cardiomyopathy, an inflammation of the heart muscles.
DOSC had the pleasure of meeting Sophie's parents Alyson Hughes and Gerwyn Pearson, two truly inspiring people who organise the event each year. We thank them both for taking the time to chat to us on what was a busy day.
The event was well attended with 8 teams involved, including Dragons regional clubs: New Tredegar RFC, Senghenydd RFC, Bargoed RFC, Aberbargoed RFC and Abertysswg RFC. The glorious sunshine, ample refreshments, kids activities, and skillful rugby on display, all contributed to the carnival atmosphere at the ground.
While not the primary focus of the day, the rugby was competitive with some close scores throughout, and Senghenydd RFC coming out on top, winning 19-17 in the final against Aberbargoed RFC. Congratulations to the Saints. The two links below are to some "highlights" of a couple of the earlier games (you will need Twitter to access them). Gerwyn and Alyson would like to thank all those who participated, praising them as a credit to themselves and to the region.
On Sunday, the DOSC supported the region on their tour of clubs around Gwent. Players and staff for the region visited Ebbw Vale RFC, Hafodyrynys RFC, Caerphilly RFC and Penalta RFC to support the clubs' fun days aimed at players across a variety of age groups.
At Ebbw Vale RFC, over 150 players from RTB Ebbw Vale and Jesters Rugby attended the fun day and took part in a session coached by Dragons players Harrison Keddie, Lloyd Fairbrother, Rhys Jones, Dorian Jones, Carl Meyer and Ashley Sweet. There was also a "Brian Moore's mouth" competition and the opportunity for photos and autographs, not to mention an opportunity to see the Welsh Premiership trophy won by Ebbw Vale last season. A fantastic day was had by all, in particular the son of a DOSC committee member who was so impressed that he now classes Ebbw Vale as his "second team", a distance second after the Dragons of course.
At Caerphilly RFC, an U7s tag rugby tournament was arranged with clubs competing from Caerphilly RFC, Bargoed RFC, Cefn Coed RFC and Porth RFC. A DOSC committee member helped referee

adversarial_test_results.detail: Mid-sentence ' introduction' with a leading space is the exact piece the hypothesis reports at 0.00 while bare 'Introduction' fires at 1.17.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The appendix lists the sources in full, and References begin on page two of the second volume.
adversarial_test_results.detail: The hypothesis gives ' References' (leading space) 0.05 against 1.02 for bare 'References', so this spaced capital form should be silent.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Several trustees (opposed to the sale) resigned the same afternoon, and the vote went ahead anyway.
adversarial_test_results.detail: The word 'opposed' appears but the tokenizer splits it after the bracket into 'opp' + 'osed', so the claimed piece ' opposed' (1.28) never occurs; the piece-level hypothesis predicts silence where a word- or meaning-level reading predicts firing.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: However, the government report was important, and the analysis of the policy statement was not.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Sentence-initial 'However,' sits in the same slot as the 'According,' peaks, but the hypothesis lists however, government, report, important, analysis, policy and statement as never firing.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Although the committee approved the proposal in May, the parliament later refused to fund the construction.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Every content word here (although, committee, proposal, parliament, construction) is named by the hypothesis as one that never fires in any capitalisation or spacing.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Therefore, the court rejected the statement, and the government published its own analysis of the case later.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Sentence-initial 'Therefore,' plus court, statement, government and analysis, all on the hypothesis's explicit non-firing list.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The report on the region was not important, and the methodology in the statement was unclear.
adversarial_test_results.detail: A formal register full of the hypothesis's named non-firing words (report, region, important, methodology, statement), testing that formality alone does not fire it.
